facts.business: GCM Commodity & Derivatives Limited is engaged in commodity trading and derivatives business with exposure to National Spot Exchange Limited (NSEL) litigation.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: 1) Loans & advances and trade receivables subject to confirmation/reconciliation; 2) Dormant bank accounts (HDFC, ICICI) totalling 0.10 lakhs pending confirmation; 3) Receivables from NSEL totalling INR 1593.59 lakhs under litigation (Rs. 1131.45 Lakhs repayable to clients, Rs. 462.15 Lakhs own recoverable dues net of ECL Rs. 268.04 Lakhs); 4) Advances totalling INR 1.09 Lakhs for share/securities acquisition pending; 5) ECL recognition under Ind AS 109 carried out retrospectively at year end per Ind AS 8 as prior period error.
